notes.title: No Players Online Demo Localisation Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44958780/43e2eaa4f0ca1170baee45cad9094f622a72d5df.png

hello everyone!
we've been hard at work on no players online. part of the work has been put into localising the demo.

we've localised the demo for the following languages:
- simplified chinese
- traditional chinese
- brazilian portuguese
- polish
- korean
- japanese
- russian

all these languages will also be supported for the full release of no players online!

more updates to follow...
